title: Lotto formula listing
description: A listing of lookup formulas: numbers to search for in one draw, and the bets to play when they are found. The JSON form of the lotto-convergence .frm format, produced by scripts/convert_formulas.py and read by scripts/formula.py --listing.

name.description: The listing's own name, as its author wrote it.

source.description: File this listing was converted from, when it was converted.

size.description: How many numbers each formula searches for (.frm SearchNum).

wheels.description: How many wheels those numbers must be spread over, each holding exactly one of them (.frm SearchDrm).

lookback.description: How many draws back the retrovisione reaches: a bet whose numbers already came out on the matching wheels within it is rejected (.frm Rear).

formula_count.description: How many formulas the listing holds. Derived; present for convenience.

index.description: 1-based position of the formula within the listing.

numbers.description: The numeri di ricerca: what must come out for the formula to match.

bets.description: The bets to play, one list per kind. Every kind is present and any of them may be empty.
Every bet of one kind. Empty when the formula plays none of that kind.
